prompt: A photorealistic marsh at dusk. A great crane (the bird) standing in still water, its body assembled from old kerosene lanterns — some lit gold, some dark — the light doubling in the water. Reeds, a thin moon, 85mm, 2:3 aspect ratio.
promptEn: A photorealistic marsh at dusk. A great crane (the bird) standing in still water, its body assembled from old kerosene lanterns — some lit gold, some dark — the light doubling in the water. Reeds, a thin moon, 85mm, 2:3 aspect ratio.
promptZh: 一个写实风格的沼泽，时间为 黄昏。一只大鹤（鸟类）伫立在静止的水面上，它的身体由 旧煤油灯 组成——有些发出金色的光，有些则处于暗处——灯光在水中形成倒影。芦苇，一弯新月，85mm 镜头，2:3 画幅。
